claim: External longitudinal single-cell blood-transcriptome work profiles pregnancy trajectories in rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and healthy controls.
future_grounding_route: Use only as a source route for future pregnancy-comparator grounding; it does not substitute for postpartum MS immune trajectory data.
project_use: External RA/SLE pregnancy-comparator context for V49 review; not evidence for MS postpartum APC-arm behavior or treatment-response transfer.

source.citation: Lien et al. Single-cell resolution of longitudinal blood transcriptome profiles in rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus and healthy control pregnancies. Annals of the Rheumatic Diseases. 2024.
source.label: Annals of the Rheumatic Diseases RA/SLE pregnancy single-cell transcriptome study

why_unverifiable: The project has not imported and rerun the external pregnancy single-cell dataset in this external layer.
